name: vector-function-constant-sum
rationale: The compiled replacement for the hand-written top-level kernel_vector_function_constant.ll, whose function-constant global has no !air.function_constants entry, so a value supplied for index 0 names no declared constant. This AIR is xcrun metal's output for the same .metal and carries Metal's own spelling of a uint4 function constant: the air.fc_initializer global `_Z12vector_value.MTL_FC_INIT_0_Dv4_j`, which !air.function_constants names at index 0 with type uint4, and an air.static_init constructor listed in llvm.global_ctors that copies it into the program-scope constant `_ZL12vector_value` the kernel reads. One invocation sums the four lanes of the authored value (1, 2, 3, 4) and writes 10 into a poisoned output word. The lanes are distinct, so a dropped or repeated lane changes the sum (x broadcast gives 4, w broadcast 16, xyz alone 6), and reading the program-scope constant without the constructor's copy would not give the authored value. The AIR has no loop.

name: linked-single-unit-decoupled-lookback-scan-mul
rationale: One one-thread threadgroup processes one scan element. scanElements, elementsPerThread, threadgroups, both outer-axis lengths, all temporary-array extents, and every NDArray size and stride are one, bounding each lookback and element loop to the single dispatched lane.

name: a-decoupled-lookback-chain-that-yields-publishes-every-prefix
rationale: The spin llvm.agx3.yield exists for, across threadgroups (owned fixture rfs_agx_yield). 64 threadgroups of 32 threads; lane 0 of each takes a ticket g from the atomic counter in buffer 0, then spins with relaxed atomic loads on state[g - 1] (buffer 1), yielding min(k, 64) on spin k, until that word's low bit is set, and publishes ((prefix(g - 1) + g + 1) << 1) | 1 with a relaxed atomic store. The bound: the spin gives up after cap = 2^20 tries (buffer 2, a literal input), so every loop is finite; a group that gives up publishes nothing. Tickets are taken in start order, so a waiting group's predecessor has started, and the state words do not depend on which group took which ticket: state[g] = ((g + 1)(g + 2) / 2) << 1 | 1 for g in 0..64 (state[63] = 0x1041). Measured on the M3 Max and the M4 (EVs RFS-yield-m3/-m4, 1,024 groups): every prefix published, no group reached its cap, with and without the yield. A zero word means a group gave up (a lost publication or a spin that never sees its predecessor), a wrong odd word a wrong prefix.

name: agx-yields-between-device-stores-and-loads-change-no-word
rationale: llvm.agx3.yield on our own MSL (the owned fixture rfs_agx_yield, whose calls of a declared rfs_yield(ushort) the air-rename directive renames to the intrinsic, because MSL cannot spell llvm.agx3.*). One threadgroup of 64 threads; thread i yields with operands 0, n, i and 65535 (n = 300 from buffer 1) between a store of i * 2654435761 to out[i], a reload of it, a store of (reload + 1) XOR hash to out[64 + i], and a store of n + i to out[128 + i]. Measured on the M3 Max and the M4 (EVs RFS-yield-m3/-m4), the yield only pauses, so every word is its arithmetic: out[i] = i * 0x9e3779b1, out[64 + i] = (out[i] + 1) ^ out[i], out[128 + i] = 300 + i, and all 768 bytes are written over the 0xab fill. A translation that drops a store or reload around a yield, or reads the yield's operand as data, moves a word.

name: selection-material-group-23-zero-constants
rationale: The clipping helper's only backedge exits at an unsigned 16-bit counter value of 32, so one fragment invocation executes at most 32 loop iterations.

name: read-and-write-a-texture-the-pipeline-does-not-provide
rationale: Metal answers a texture operation on a resource the pipeline does not provide with a zero read and a store that goes nowhere, and `provide_absent` is false here, so `absent_source` and `absent_sink` are exactly that resource. Measured on device: dest comes back [present(0,0) | 0 | 42 | 42]. Lane (0,0) copies the LIVE read, lane (1,0) copies the ABSENT read, the second row writes 42 so an unwritten texel is not mistaken for a zero one, and every lane then stores -1 into the absent sink LAST -- so a store that failed to vanish is the value read back. The two reads sit in separate lanes over separate coordinates on purpose: given one expression over one coordinate Metal's own optimizer coalesces them onto a single handle and both answer zero, which measures the optimizer and not the rule. No corpus source's authored case reaches lower_null_texture_result, lower_absent_texture_write or absent_texture_operand_is_certain, so the whole absent-resource contract had no device evidence before this case; before the fix that ships with it the translator recovered both operands onto `present` and `dest` -- the module's only other 2D read and write -- and returned all -1.

name: parameter-block-read-through-a-by-value-buffer
rationale: Eight threads read a 160-byte parameter block (40 floats, k/2+1) through a constant pointer whose buffer node is the read-only device char node Apple's compiler writes for a by-value argument, and each writes rect + m[i & 3] * a + float4(n[i % 3], e), compared exactly.

name: visible-table-clear-slots-two-through-twenty-dual-output
rationale: One invocation calls visible-function-table slots 2 through 20 and receives exact float4 zero from all nineteen linked _uber_clear bodies. A twenty-two-word size table and eight explicit argument-info records keep every selector and offset in bounds; register 2 is selected. This entry swizzles it to float4(0,0,0,1), writes both required poisoned output textures, and captures binding zero byte-exactly.

name: simd-shuffle-and-fill-down-with-a-modulo-in-a-vertex-function
rationale: Forty rasterization-disabled points; vertex v writes simd_shuffle_and_fill_down(in[v], -in[v], 3, 32) to out[v]: the input of the lane three above in its simdgroup, or the negated input of the lane that many past the end. Metal runs this form, with an explicit modulo, in a vertex function (its compiler refuses the form without one there). A device must support subgroup operations in the vertex stage.

name: fragment-varying-float4-passthrough
rationale: The fragment entry returns its perspective center float4 varying unchanged; the shared generated fullscreen vertex stage supplies the declared varying and the selected RGBA32Float pixel captures interpolation byte-exactly.

name: reset-irradiance-indirect-count
rationale: The loop-free entry ignores its grid index and unconditionally replaces the complete poisoned four-byte irradiance-cache indirect-entry counter with aligned i32 zero.

name: runtime-slot-sampler-1d-linear-mirrored-repeat-rgba32-float
rationale: A sample through a runtime sampler bound at slot 0 against the same state as a constexpr sampler (linear filter, mirrored_repeat, normalized coordinates), at the base level at 512 coordinates (half anywhere across and beyond the texture, half at 1/256 steps around texel centres): a 9-texel rgba32_float texture of seeded random texels, the constexpr result and the slot result written in turn. Metal filters the two alike (EV MSFZ-m4-probe1); the translation emulates the slot sampler's linear filter through its SamplerState specialization.

Metal filters the two alike (EV MSFZ-m4-probe1); the translation emulates the slot sampler's linear filter through its SamplerState specialization.

name: runtime-slot-sampler-cube-linear-rgba8-unorm-srgb
rationale: A linear sample through a runtime sampler bound at slot 0 against the same state as a constexpr sampler, the constexpr result and the slot result written in turn, at the base level at 512 coordinates (half anywhere across and beyond the texture, half at 1/256 steps around texel centres), on the seeded random texels of the runtime-slot-sampler-cube-linear-rgba8-unorm case read as rgba8_unorm_srgb. Metal answers a runtime sampler as its constexpr sampler of the same state on the 8-bit sRGB formats (EV TXN-srgbprobe-m4); the translation sums the raw codes' table steps where the slot's word reaches the emulation. A cube's runtime sample is the inference this case measures.

name: linked-single-invocation-zero-bin
rationale: One invocation is bounded by source_size 1x1. Linking is enabled with one authored texture and one address-table element; the exact callback is loop-free and returns float4 zero without dereferencing either resource. The one-bin histogram parameters force every active scalar lane to bin zero, and the poisoned counter makes the bounded global-atomic write observable byte-exactly.

name: residency-of-samples-whose-addressing-clamps-to-or-replaces-an-unmapped-edge
rationale: Whether a texel the sampler's addressing clamps to (clamp_to_edge) or replaces (clamp_to_border, an opaque white border color) counts toward a sample's or gather's residency on a sparse texture; Only the clamp_to_zero border was measured. A sparse texture is made on Metal from a sparse heap of 16 KiB pages and mapped with MTLResourceStateCommandEncoder before the work, and on Vulkan as a sparse resident image bound with vkQueueBindSparse; Only the mapped texels' authored bytes are uploaded. Each region is a whole number of tiles on every device that runs the case (an executor refuses a region that is not whole tiles of its device), so the mapped texels are the same wherever the case runs; each run prints its tiling. Texture 0 is 256x128 r32_float with texel (x, y) = 1000y + x + 1 (exact) and its right 128x128 mapped, so the left edge column x = 0 is unmapped. Thread i runs probe i of buffer 0 (32 bytes: kind, 0, u, v, then four 0 floats) and writes out[2i] = the raw bits of the probe's float4 value and out[2i+1] = (resident() ? 1 : 0, kind, i, 0x5A5). The output is pre-filled with 0xAB, so an unwritten word shows; the AIR has no loop. Kinds: 0 sparse_sample through a constexpr nearest clamp_to_edge normalized sampler at level(0), 1 the same linear, 2 sparse_gather through the nearest edge sampler, 3 to 5 the same through clamp_to_border samplers. Positions in texels X = u * 256 (v = 8.5 / 128 unless noted): 0: -128, 384, (192, y -64), (192, y 192); 1: -128, 384, (192, y -64), 128.5, 128.25, 0.5, -0.5; 2: -128, 384, 256; 3: -128, 0.5, 384; 4: -128, 0.25, -0.25, -1, -0.5; 5: -128, 0, 384. Every coordinate is a dyadic fraction, exact in float, and u * 256 is exact.

name: half-conversion-by-read-only-and-read-write-texture-reads
rationale: How Metal converts texels to half when a texture declared access::read or access::read_write reads them (half-conversion-of-wider-texels-by-read-and-sample reads access::sample textures). Four 16x16 read-only half textures, rgba32_float values around half rounding boundaries (ties, near ties, the overflow edge, subnormals, signed zeros, infinities, NaN, random), rgba16_unorm codes nearest a half tie with endpoints and random codes, and rgba8_unorm and rgba8_unorm_srgb with every code per channel; and two 16x16 read-write half textures, rgba32_float and rgba8_unorm with values of the same kinds. Lane i reads texel (i mod 16, i div 16) of each and writes the six results widened to float to out[6i..6i+5] of buffer 0, pre-filled with 0xAB. The AIR has no loop.

name: visible-table-clear-slots-two-through-twenty-seven
rationale: One invocation calls visible-function-table slots 2 through 27 and receives exact float4 zero from all twenty-six linked _uber_clear bodies. A twenty-nine-word size table and eight explicit argument-info records keep every selector and offset in bounds; the final selector reads register 2 and writes exact zero to the poisoned primary texel.

name: visible-table-clear-slots-two-through-six-threadgroup-primary
rationale: One invocation calls visible-function-table slots 2 through 6 and receives exact float4 zero from all five linked _uber_clear bodies. An eight-word size table and eight explicit argument-info records keep every selector and offset in bounds; register 2 is selected. The single-invocation threadgroup executes both barriers over internal static storage and writes the linked result to the poisoned primary texel byte-exactly.

name: visible-table-clear-slots-two-through-eleven-dual-output
rationale: One invocation calls visible-function-table slots 2 through 11 and receives exact float4 zero from all ten linked _uber_clear bodies. A thirteen-word size table and eight explicit argument-info records keep every selector and offset in bounds; register 2 is selected. This entry swizzles it to float4(0,0,0,1), writes both required poisoned output textures, and captures binding zero byte-exactly.

name: linked-single-unit-ArrayMultiplyNTLinking
rationale: One invocation multiplies a 1x1 matrix pair with K equal to one. Matrix dimensions, batch counts, split counts, and NDArray extents are one; row and allocation byte strides are the exact four-byte float width, bounding every matrix and batch loop. The array declares three elements. Metal reports the third as `missing Buffer binding at index 2 for buffers.2[0]`, so every earlier observation of this case read undefined memory for it. It is authored 3.0, distinct from the 1.0 of element zero, and the written value was measured invariant under it: setting the operand pair to 2.0 and 3.0 also writes zero. This case pins the zero the linked kernel writes, not a product.

name: linked-single-ulong-transpose-write
rationale: One dispatched invocation addresses one NDArray element. The reference-size and coordinate-mapping constants bound every dimension and stride to one; the linked prefix returns an exact nonzero value, the linked postfix writes it, and both callbacks are loop-free. Transpose variants use one initialized lane and the exact reflected dynamic threadgroup allocation.

name: bounded-dynamic-visible-table-clear-slot-two-2x2-output
rationale: The literal four-word size table [4, 0, 0, 0] bounds the only reachable loop: its induction starts at visible-table slot 2, increments once to 3, and exits because the masked first word minus one is exactly 3. One invocation takes the non-empty path because the authored bounds are float2(1), calls visible-function-table slot 2, and receives exact float4 zero from the linked _uber_clear body without dereferencing callback arguments. Eight explicit argument-info records keep every selector and offset in bounds. This entry writes a 2x2 block at primary-texture origin (2,0); the 4x2 poisoned resource contains that full footprint, which is selected for byte-exact comparison.

name: visible-table-clear-slots-two-through-thirteen-2x1-output
rationale: One invocation calls visible-function-table slots 2 through 13 and receives exact float4 zero from all twelve linked _uber_clear bodies. A fifteen-word size table and eight explicit argument-info records keep every selector and offset in bounds; register 2 is selected. The complete 2x1 primary block at origin (2,0) is captured byte-exactly from the poisoned 4x1 resource.
